issues.where: the whole land mass, especially the ribcage and arms
issues.what: the skeleton barely reads: the ribs are buried in one solid brown block, the upper arm and hand are a shapeless lobe, and the gaps of open sea between the bones are filled with land, so the outline of the land is no longer that of -a
issues.fix: keep the extra land and scale, but bring the ribs back as distinct ridges with sea or shallow water between them, and make the arms, hands and spine follow the -a outline

issues.what: -a has a loose spiral of many thin, streaky cloud bands with sea showing between them. -b has a smooth, solid, airbrushed white swirl with a hard black eye and a long tail. It looks like CG and out of scale
issues.fix: break the cyclone into many fine, separated, textured bands with dark sea between them, and soften the eye. Keep it the same size and position as in -a

issues.where: the ocean surface and cloud cover across the frame
issues.what: -a has a fine, even scatter of small whitecap-like cloud streaks over all of the sea. -b swaps this for a few heavy, smeared cloud bands and large patches of clear, flat navy sea, which changes the weather
issues.fix: bring back the dense, fine, wind-aligned streak texture over the whole ocean. The layered cloud can stay, but it should be thinner and less smeared

issues.where: the pelvis and the sea to its right
issues.what: -a has a large bright white salt or snow flat with vivid red veins, and a rust-red and orange plume streaming into the sea. In -b the white patch is small, the red is faint, and the sea plume is gone
issues.fix: widen the bright white pelvis flat, strengthen the red veining, and bring back the red and ochre plume in the water to its right

issues.where: the shallow water around the bones
issues.what: -a has murky teal-green shallows with ochre and olive swirls of sediment hugging the bones. -b has deep navy sea with flat turquoise rims that end on hard edges and look cut out
issues.fix: bring back the teal-green turbid shallows with soft gradients and ochre sediment swirls. Soften the hard turquoise rims

issues.where: the inland lakes and coast edges on the land
issues.what: the lakes and inlets are flat-filled shapes with dark outlines, like a sticker over the terrain, not water in relief
issues.fix: blend the lake and shore edges into the terrain and remove the dark outline strokes

issues.where: the terrain colour along the bones
issues.what: -a's ridges are pale, almost bone-white, with sharp crests. -b's ridges are a darker, warmer brown, so the bone pallor is lost
issues.fix: lift the ridge crests toward the pale grey-white of -a

issues.what: the glare is warmer and more orange than -a's neutral, silvery sheen
issues.fix: cool the glare toward the neutral silver of -a
